The dibutyl ester of 3,4-dihydroxy-3-cyclobutene-1,2-di- one; 3,4-Dibutoxy-3-cyclobutene-1,2-dione;. Дибутиловый Эфир Сквариковой Кислоты C12H18O4 = 226.3. CAS — 2892-62-8 (squaric acid dibutylester); 2892-51-5 (squaric acid). Profile Squaric acid dibutylester has been tried similarly to diphency- prone (p.1594) as a contact sensitiser in the treatment of alopecia. It has also been tried in warts. ◊ References. 1.
